summary: Separate continuous demo reuses real Kodama tasks. Application-owned100Hz SysTick requests runs every emulated second, one pending run/coalescing, shared cooperative dispatch; main and startup never exit normally.82 tests:74 pass/8 skipped; real QEMU/GDB1 pass. Source/ELF hashes and run oracle recorded.
validated: 79 local tests pass with real GDB17.2/QEMU11.1/GNU Arm GCC16.2, plugin, pinned old and immutable current packed Kodama ARM builds
Both real examples reach PASS and an explicit final user stop proves all tasks inactive/pool free; MI oracles validate seen and matched pool used
Pure model: identity reuse/regression epochs/retirement, stale ownership, priority/list/yield guards, unknowns, exception context and session/build replay
Headless actual mouse/keyboard/scrub/freeze/follow/expanded/theme/replay flows pass; actual-color screenshot visually inspected
Compileall and whitespace pass; GDB global reads avoid lexical shadowing and use declared target byte order
decisions: Full-width Kodama pane below source/scope, like console; auto-detect known ELF API or palette/CLI enable
Separate MI transport, raw GDB domain adapter, pure Kodama model and Textual canvas; keep generic observation exporter
Append raw Kodama kinds to dbg3k.trace.v1; API entries anchor to preceding visible stop and do not advance stop IDs
Task identity includes slot/generation plus observed discontinuity epoch; pool attribution requires live token/context/binding/handle equality
Source header labels explicitly unverified against ELF; occurrence requests/publication entries distinct from persistent level samples
No target calls or firmware changes; internal entry probes optional, changes deferred until halted
Replay uses matching ELF/session/capture and starts no GDB; history inspection never executes target
limits: UI512 samples,128 lifetime lanes;256 cached names; source header128KiB/64 labels/80-character names
One cell=sample, unequal time; logical ticks not physical duration; no complete event/invocation trace or API-success inference
Occupied pool capacity differs from actual requested frame bytes; stored allocator diagnostics conditional; shared MSP counted separately
Unobserved resets cannot prove identity; optimized/LTO variants, actual terminal and physical/IRQ capture unqualified
Probes still trap after sample cap until paused at halted stop; host overhead/interleavings affected
Real Kodama CI conditional on dedicated read token; mandatory public ARM protocol fixture is not a scheduler replacement
